source.title: Wolf
source.quote: The mean body mass of the wolf is 40 kg (88 lb)

mass_kg.note: Mean for wolves generally, not male-only. Low is the Indian and Arabian wolf average; high is where the source says wolves become uncommon.

source.title: Wolf
source.quote: Adult wolves measure 105–160 cm (41–63 in) in length

size_m.note: The source does not split by sex and lists the tail separately right after. Upper end of the stated range; the source gives no mean.

source.title: Hunting behavior of gray wolves
source.quote: Wolves can run at 56–64 km/h (35–40 mph) across several kilometers

top_speed_mps.note: Converted from 64 km/h, low from 56 km/h.

source.title: Bite club: comparative bite force in big biting mammals and the prediction of predatory behaviour in fossil taxa
source.license: Publisher copyright, not an open license; one data row cited

attack_force_n.note: Canine bite force estimated from a skull of a 34.7 kg wolf; range is +/-25%.

attacks_per_s.note: No published attack rate found for this animal; category default.

reach_m.note: reach = 0.25 x size_m (lunging bite), from size_m.

endurance_s.note: Category default (mammal). Wolves 'can maintain rapid pursuit for at least 20 minutes' (Hunting behavior of gray wolves), but that is a chase minimum, not fighting endurance.

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level 3: hunts or defends itself, avoids risky fights.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 4: pack that hunts in coordination.
